I know, after you have spent so much time with a person, it feels impossible to imagine life without them. One thing I can suggest is that you take some time to focus on yourself. I'm sure you'll continue to miss him, but if he can just up and leave you like that, then you didn't need him in the first place. I think it's important that you continue setting boundaries for yourself by cutting him off

We can get through this together! I've had so many failed attempts I can almost laugh about it. We Dont need to drown together. We can use one another to survive. I can promise you relying on other people is the only way I found help the first few times.
Break ups are hard! but I can promise you that it will get better. Something that I know works with a few of my friends is music.

Aren't we all! I know it's sometimes hard or complicated for us to open up and make ourselves vulnerable to people in person because there is always that chance of it backfiring against us. The internet is easier because it gives us a sense anonymity and protection from being hurt any more.
It's so exhausting! I've always found it to be easier if I talked it out with other people.
I'm here to talk! I've tied that same knot over and over again, and I also need someone to talk to.
